mintAuthority.summary: KRWQ has one issuer-native liability deployment on Ethereum. Its TransparentUpgradeableProxy owner (3/5 Safe 0x56398b89) controls the token minter set; the two active KRWTCustodianWithOracle minters use deposit/custodian-asset and oracle-freshness gates with current mutable 1.5 billion KRWQ caps, so native issuance is cap- and deposit-bounded but the Safe can raise caps, authorize minters, and replace mint-critical logic. Base, Polygon, Fraxtal, Codex, and Morph are LayerZero V2 OFT representations and are excluded from Mint Authority; their bridge controllers and the Ethereum OFT Adapter are recorded in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: KRWQ Ethereum owner (3/5 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770699 (2026-08-16), the KRWQ TransparentUpgradeableProxy implementation 0x350b6b5cf2bda130a9bee0a3cda86ec88e71dcca exposes minterMint(address,uint256) only to addresses in the minters mapping; the token function itself has no token-level cap, and addMinter/removeMinter are owner-only. The two active minters are KRWTCustodianWithOracle proxies 0x5573b8db24043bee020c36ee0df32694dffef04c and 0x7e88ac6a9c2dad21fea4de6b54c764ca4d99c05d, both owned by this 3-of-5 Safe. Each custodian uses deposit/custodian-asset and oracle-freshness checks and currently reports mintCap = 1,500,000,000e18; the Safe can raise those caps, add or remove minters, and owns the Ethereum mint-critical ProxyAdmins. getModules() returned empty, while current guard/fallback reads reverted, so guard state is not claimed absent.
controls.capDescription: The token's minterMint function is uncapped for an authorized minter, but the two currently authorized KRWTCustodianWithOracle contracts enforce deposit/oracle checks and 1,500,000,000 KRWQ caps. This Safe can add or remove minters and call the owner paths that raise those caps, so the reviewed native path is raiseable rather than economically unbounded.

controls.label: KRWQ Ethereum custodian minter 0x5573 (deposit/oracle; 1.5bn cap)
controls.capDescription: KRWTCustodianWithOracle mints through its deposit/custodian-asset path with oracle-freshness checks and a current mintCap of 1,500,000,000e18. The custodian cannot raise its own cap; its owner Safe controls setMintCap().
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770699, mintersArray on the verified KRWQ implementation included this KRWTCustodianWithOracle proxy. Its verified implementation exposes deposit/mint against a custodian asset, oracle freshness state, mutable mintCap, and owner-only setMintCap; the live mintCap read returned 1,500,000,000e18. The custodian owner and its ProxyAdmin owner resolve to the Ethereum 3-of-5 Safe 0x56398b89.

review.evidence: Reviewed at the Mint Authority / Bridge Risk boundary on 2026-08-16 using pinned 2026-08-16 observations. Ethereum is the only issuer-native liability route: the KRWQ token proxy is owner-controlled by the 3-of-5 Safe 0x56398b89, its two active KRWTCustodianWithOracle minters enforce deposit/custodian-asset and oracle-freshness checks with 1,500,000,000e18 caps, and the Safe can raise those caps, change the minter set, or replace the token and custodian mint-critical implementations. Base, Polygon, Fraxtal, Codex, and Morph are LayerZero OFT bridge representations; their destination mint/burn, peer, owner, and upgrade machinery, plus the Ethereum OFT Adapter escrow, are scored only under bridgeRouteRisk. The assets-only Chainlink Proof of Reserve does not reconcile total liabilities across the canonical token, Adapter, and five representations, so reconciliation remains unknown and no independent supervisor is evidenced.
